senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19

traits.name: Lightning Breath
traits.description: The dragon exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

multiattack_text: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
